finite_stop: stop after certified positive rank reopens on the next unique root box
theorem: The three consecutive pseudo-arclength root boxes at steps 21--23 are unique and have strictly positive outward full-row-rank lower bounds. The smallest certified sampled bound occurs at step 22 and the bound reopens by more than one order of magnitude at step 23. This excludes rank loss inside each certified root box and justifies the declared finite near-event stop. It does not cover every connecting path point and therefore is not a theorem that step 22 is the continuous global minimum.
